create_simulation_server: create an ARESimulationGuiServer instance with hostname, port, and scenario configuration parameters
run_simulation_server: run the ARESimulationGuiServer to start the FastAPI and GraphQL endpoints on the specified host
create_frontend_route: create a frontend route that serves static files from the client build directory
get_or_create_are_simulation: get or create an ARESimulationGui instance for a given session ID with lazy initialization
stop_simulation_server: stop the ARESimulationGuiServer and clean up active sessions via the session manager
